game.core.world.secret.summary: A fey-touched cat with a will of its own has been quietly herding sheep into a hidden glen in Sable Hollow, keeping them as its own odd little kingdom -- not malicious, just lonely and mischievous. It can understand speech even if it doesn't answer. Expected solution path: track it (Survival/Perception), follow it into the Hollow, and either negotiate, play, or simply be kind to it rather than fight -- violence toward it should feel wrong and unnecessary once found. This cat may be the same one hinted at in Ganji's cat-companion hook; GM discretion on making the connection explicit. Reward: the shepherds' genuine gratitude, 20 gp, a wheel of cheese, and 50 XP; a possible ongoing feline companion if Ganji makes friends with it.
